new_value: Fixed duplicate out-of-bounds bug in hash-based channel selection (line 166). Removed faulty n_channels.max(3) clamping that returned invalid channel indices when n_channels < 3. Now returns channel 0 when n_channels < 2 (no data channels available), otherwise correctly computes 1 + (h % (n_channels - 1)) for valid range [1, n_channels-1]. Same fix applied to synchronized_hop_channel (line 103). Updated test to verify correct behavior.
